entities.name: Marcos Carneiro de Mendonça
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcos Cláudio Phillipe Carneiro de Mendonça was a Brazilian footballer who achieved notoriety playing for Fluminense and the Brazil national football team. He was the inaugural goalkeeper for Brazil and played a key role in Brazil's first ever international trophy, the 1919 South American Championship.
